register_magnum_printers: register all Magnum GDB pretty-printers for debugging C++ types like Matrix, Vector, and Quaternion in gdb
build_magnum_printer: build the RegexpCollectionPrettyPrinter that maps Magnum C++ type regex patterns to their corresponding Python printer classes
create_MagnumTypePrinter: create a custom GDB pretty-printer class by subclassing MagnumTypePrinter and implementing to_string for a new C++ type
review_MagnumMatrix: review the MagnumMatrix pretty-printer class that parses template arguments to display row and column counts for Matrix types
summarize_MagnumVectorColor: summarize the MagnumVectorColor pretty-printer that formats Math::Vector and Math::Color types by iterating over dimension components
